scope: To-do discovery, confirmed file and section deletion, shared workspace spacing

browser.data: temporary QA workspace, separate from personal data
visualChecks: Vocabulary mobile and computed toolbar alignment
interactions: Task creation with Enter, retained across navigation
Task deletion cancelled with Escape and focus returned
File deletion confirmed, removed from Library, Undo offered
Deleted file visible in Trash and restored
Section created and deleted through file explorer

limitations: All-section overflow checks used a temporary workspace; every populated state on every page was not exercised.
Installed desktop changes require quitting and reopening the app.
